disclaimer: Educational/informational content only. Not registered investment advice under SEBI or any other regulator. Accuracy percentages are a simple historical correlation within this tracked universe, not a forward-looking guarantee. Always do your own research.
methodology_note: Strategy picks are computed relative to the median of this 217-stock tracked watchlist (40 Blue Chip / 40 Emerging / 200 Smart Pick universe, de-duplicated), not the whole market. 'Accuracy' checks whether stocks meeting a strategy's criteria also had a positive historical stock price CAGR over a comparable window. This is a larger sample than the original 9-stock demo but still an illustrative cross-sectional check, not a rigorous walk-forward backtest. Some financial-services/newly-listed stocks show 'null' for a field screener.in doesn't report for that company type (e.g. ROCE for banks/NBFCs, or CAGR for recent IPOs) - these are excluded from that specific median/strategy check rather than treated as zero.

value.label: Value
value.description: Below-median P/E and above-median ROE within the 217-stock tracked universe.

growth.label: Growth
growth.description: Above-median 3-year profit growth and above-median 3-year sales growth.

technical.label: Technical / Momentum
technical.description: 1-year stock price CAGR at or above the tracked universe's median (proxy for momentum).

smartpick.label: Smart Pick
smartpick.description: Qualifies under at least 2 of the 3 strategies above (Value/Growth/Technical).
